Attention, please. This is an announcement for passengers to Rome. The high-speed train to Roma Termini, leaving at ten fifteen, is delayed by twenty minutes. The new departure time is ten thirty-five. This train now leaves from platform eight, not platform five. Please check the timetable on the screen. The trip to Rome takes one hour and thirty minutes. Passengers with a regional ticket, please validate your ticket in the green machine before you get on the train. We are sorry for the delay. Thank you.

Hi Marlene, it is Giulia from Hotel Firenze. Paul told me you are going to Rome tomorrow. Here is a little tip. When you arrive at Termini station, do not take a taxi to the Colosseum. The subway is faster and cheaper. Take line B, the blue line. Which direction? Take the train to Laurentina. The Colosseum stop is called Colosseo, and it is only two stops from Termini. It takes about five minutes. When you get off, follow the exit signs, and you can see the Colosseum right in front of you. Have a wonderful day in Rome.

First, you look at the timetable on the big screen in Florence. Then you validate your ticket in the green machine. Next, you go to platform eight and you get on the train. After that, you arrive at Roma Termini and you take the subway, line B. Finally, you follow the exit signs and you see the Colosseum.
